name: steer
description: Engineering standards for GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code). On the Copilot CLI this manifest loads steer's skills and a Copilot-native hook set; in both surfaces the always-on rules are delivered as .github/copilot-instructions.md and the skills as a cross-tool .agents/skills/ tree in the open Agent Skills format (installed by /steer:init), since Copilot has no context-injecting SessionStart hook.
